LanguageData.OH_Contact_default: {0} made contact from captivity and provided basic information about their location. A rescue mission is now available.
LanguageData.OH_Contact_bonded_animal_courier: {0}'s bonded animal arrived injured but alive, carrying a message about the kidnap camp. The animal will join your colony if the rescue succeeds.
LanguageData.OH_Contact_caravan_smuggled_note: {0} slipped a note to a passing caravan. The traders brought you the kidnap camp's location, and your relationship with their faction has improved.
LanguageData.OH_Contact_hacked_comms_burst: {0} hacked into their captors' communications. The brief signal contained information about the camp, but the effort left them injured.
LanguageData.OH_Contact_coded_art_trade: {0} hid a coded message in a piece of traded artwork. The message reveals the prison's location, and traders will offer the artwork for sale.
LanguageData.OH_Contact_knotted_item_on_road: {0} left coded items along the trade routes. One of your colonists found the message while traveling. Check the map edge for the hidden information.
LanguageData.OH_Contact_structural_flaw_note: {0} found a weak point in the prison. Their message identifies a wall that can be collapsed to open another way in.
LanguageData.OH_Contact_ore_chunk_message: {0} hid a message in mined ore. You found it inside silver that appeared on the colony map. The information is useful, but the rescue window is shorter.
LanguageData.OH_Contact_mass_food_poisoning: {0} poisoned their captors' food. The camp is in chaos, the guards are weaker, and security has tightened. The rescue window is shorter.
LanguageData.OH_Contact_indebted_prisoner: {0} saved another prisoner's life. That prisoner will help with the rescue, giving you another ally at the kidnap camp.
LanguageData.OH_Contact_hijacked_guard_radio: {0} hijacked a guard's radio during a raid on your colony. If the attack is still underway, reinforcements will arrive to help.
LanguageData.OH_Rumor_Sighting: A trader saw someone matching {0}'s description being moved between camps. They're still alive, but no one knows where they are now.
LanguageData.OH_Rumor_Trader: A caravan found some of {0}'s belongings at an abandoned campsite. They were there recently, but the trail has gone cold.
LanguageData.OH_Rumor_Escape: Someone matching {0}'s description tried to escape. The attempt failed, but they're still fighting.
LanguageData.OH_Rumor_Condition: Rumors say {0} may be injured or ill. There may not be much time left to rescue them.
LanguageData.OH_RescueSuccessText: {0} is free and can return home, though captivity may have left its mark.
LanguageData.OH_ReturnRaidText: {0} has returned with a {1} raiding party. They appear to be fighting beside your enemies, but their true loyalty is unclear.
LanguageData.OH_LoyaltyBetrayalMessage: {0} has turned on their captors and rejoined your side.
LanguageData.OH_PrisonBreakText: {0} has found a chance to escape. Guide them through it and get them home alive.
